page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include any bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Additionally, the instance features no integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource distribution, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a predictable performance profile for entry-level workloads without the performance variability associated with shared-core or burstable instances. It is qualitatively positioned as a cost-effective option for lightweight applications, small-scale web serving, development environments, and basic database hosting where massive parallel processing or high memory footprints are not required.
